sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Pre-Emption Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT X OF 1992
ACT X OF 1992
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PRE-EMPTION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Pre-emption
Act, 1987
[Gazette of N:
W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th December, 1992]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/23968, dated
16-12-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Pre-emption (Amendment) Bill,
1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 13th December, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 14th December, 1992, is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
North-West Frontier Province Pre-emption (Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect on the 31st December, 1991.

sections.shortTitle: N -W F P Pre-Emption Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Amendment of Section 12 of N.W.F.P. Act X of 1987

ACT X OF 1992
ACT X OF 1992
NORTH-WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE PRE-EMPTION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1992
An Act further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Pre-emption
Act, 1987
[Gazette of N:
W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th December, 1992]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/23968, dated
16-12-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Pre-emption (Amendment) Bill,
1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 13th December, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 14th December, 1992, is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
2. Amendment of Section 12 of N.-W.F.P. Act X of 1987.-- In the
North-West Frontier Province Pre-emption Act, 1987 (N.-W.F.P. Act X of 1987),
hereinafter referred to as the said Act, for section 12 the following shall be
substituted, namely:--
"12.
Notice of intention to sell.--(1) Where any person proposes to sell any
immovable property in respect of which a right of pre-emption exists, he may
give notice to all such persons having such right of the price at which he is
willing to sell the property.
(2) The notice
under subsection (1) shall be given through any Court within the local limits
of whose jurisdiction such immovable property is situated and shall be deemed
sufficiently given if it be stuck upon the main entrance of a mosque and on any
other public place of the village, city or place where the property is
situated."

ACT X OF 1992

An Act further to amend the North-West Frontier Province Pre-emption
Act, 1987
[Gazette of N:
W.F.P., Extraordinary, 16th December, 1992]
No. PA/NWFP/Legis/92/23968, dated
16-12-1992.--The North-West Frontier Province Pre-emption (Amendment) Bill,
1992, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the North-West Frontier
Province on the 13th December, 1992 and assented to by the Governor of the
North-West Frontier Province on the 14th December, 1992, is hereby published as
an Act of the Provincial Legislature of North-West Frontier Province.
6. Amendment of section 24 of N.-W.F.P. Act X of 1987.--In the said
Act, in section 24, for subsections (1), (2) and (3), the following subsections
shall respectively be substituted, namely:--
"24.
Plaintiff to deposit sale price of the property.--(1) In every suit for
pre-emption the Court shall require the plaintiff to deposit in such Court one third
of the sale price of the property in cash within such period as the Court may
fix :
Provided that
if no sale price is mentioned in the sale-deed or in the mutation, the Court
shall require the deposit of one-third of the probable value of the property.
(2) Where the
plaintiff fails to deposit one-third of the sale price or the probable value of
the property within the period fixed by the Court, his suit shall be dismissed.
(3) Where the
plaintiff withdraws the sum deposited under subsection (1), his suit shall be
dismissed.".
